newsitem.title: USA: Boston Scientific jumps after Q2 comment.
newsitem.headline: Boston Scientific jumps after Q2 comment.

text.p: Shares in Boston Scientific Corp jumped 10 percent on Tuesday after the company said it expected to post results showing a 25 percent rise in second quarter revenue.

Lehman Brothers analyst Amelia McDonald said in a summary report that the company's statement gave her "increased confidence" in her second quarter earnings per share forecast for Boston Scientific of $0.47.
According to First Call the mean estimate among analysts for Boston Scientific's second quarter is $0.44 a share, with a range of $0.40 to $0.47.
Shares in Boston Scientific rose 6-3/8 to 69-5/8.

The stock has gradually recovered ground since dropping to as low as 41 in April after the company warned in advance of reporting its first quarter numbers that the results would not meet analysts' expectations.
Late Monday, the medical device company said net sales for the second quarter ended June 30 increased 25 percent to $474 million compared to $379 million in the second quarter of 1996.
Without the impact of changes in exchange rates, net sales for the second quarter increased 28 percent, the company said.
Boston Scientific said the revenue growth in the quarter was in line with its expectations. It said it expects to release complete financial results for the second quarter later in the month.
A Deutsche Morgan Grenfell analyst upgraded Boston Scientific to buy from accumulate. The analyst was not available for comment.
